### Props

| Name           | Type                                    | Required | Default | Description                                                                                            |
| -------------- | --------------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `value`        | `union`                                 |          | `null`  | Current selection — the catalogue's emitted value, a URL, or null.                                     |
| `icons`        | `Array<object>`                         |          | `[]`    | The resolved catalogue to browse: `[{ key, label, value, search?, path?, component? }]`.               |
| `urlIcons`     | `Array<{ label: string, url: string }>` |          | `[]`    | Curated image-URL icons for the Custom tab: `[{ label, url }]`.                                        |
| `uploadFn`     | `union`                                 |          | `null`  | Injected upload transport: `async (dataUrl) =&gt; ({ url })`. When null, the upload control is hidden. |
| `maxResults`   | `number`                                |          | `150`   | Maximum number of icon cells rendered in the grid at once.                                             |
| `defaultIcons` | `string[]`                              |          | `[]`    | Catalogue `key`s to show when the search box is empty.                                                 |
| `showLabels`   | `boolean`                               |          | `false` | Show the human-readable label under each icon cell.                                                    |
| `allowUrl`     | `boolean`                               |          | `false` | Offer a free-text image-URL input on the Custom tab.                                                   |

| Name    | Payload | Description                                                                                         |
| ------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `input` | —       | Emitted with the new icon value (path / name / URL / null).                                         |
| `pick`  | —       | Emitted on a discrete selection so the parent can close the popover (not fired while typing a URL). |
